messages:
eva: FYI discovered a reproducible failure onboarding a HF model when we quantize with q4_k_m. tool-calls that emit JSON-mode wrappers are sometimes losing the space between role markers and the <JSON_START> marker, which breaks our json parsing in the eval harness.

aj: hm, do you have a minimal repro? sounds like a token boundary shift. seen that before when special tokens and prefixed spaces interact with byte-level tokenization. :thinking:

eva: paste of the failing exchange: 
```
assistant: <JSON_START>{"tool":"search","args":{"q":"redwood quantize"}}<JSON_END>
```
After q4_k_m, tokenizer sometimes yields: `assistant:<JSON_START>{...}` (no space). Parser chokes.

maria: two likely causes: (1) conversion didn't register `<JSON_START>` as a separate special token in tokenizer config.json, or (2) quantization pruned embedding rows such that adjacent tokens merge into one token id sequence. check `tokenizer.add_prefix_space` and special_tokens_map.

kevin: quick diagnostic I ran: convert with our `rw-hf-import` -> inspect tokenizer.tokenize for sequence `"\u2019" + <JSON_START>` and for `role_token + <JSON_START>` combos. With add_prefix_space=false we see merges. With add_prefix_space=true they separate.

aj: other mitigations: (a) register an explicit role delimiter char (we used U+FFF0 in earlier chat-template fixes), (b) pin special token embeddings during quantize so rows aren't pruned, (c) post-conversion patch that forces insertion of a whitespace between role and marker at generation time (hacky).

eva: pros/cons? pinning protects stability but costs size. delim char may leak into logs or downstream tokenizers if not handled. generation-time patch is brittle.

maria: implementation plan: short-term -> patch converter to ensure `<JSON_START>` and `<JSON_END>` are in `special_tokens` and set `add_prefix_space=true` when building tokenizer; add unit tests. medium-term -> quantizer option to pin a small set of special tokens (configurable in quantize manifest).

kevin: I'll open PR `kevin/hf-quantize-specialtoken-stability` with two commits: (1) conversion + tokenizer test for role+marker combos, (2) quantizer tweak that accepts `--pin-embeddings token1,token2`. I'll include a tiny eval that runs the three failure modes (normal, merged, missing-space) and asserts JSON parse success.

aj: add a benchmark note: pinning the ~8 special tokens increases q4_k_m artifact by ~3-5MB in my run; worth flagging in the PR description and in the onboarding docs.

ops-bot: CI queued for branch `kevin/hf-quantize-specialtoken-stability` :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria: nice. eva, can you upload the failing model conversion log + the small eval harness trace here when available? I'll re-run evals once PR lands. :thumbsup:

eva: will do, uploading logs and the failing harness case in a follow-up message. thanks all for the quick triage.
